bench.deviceRemoved: The GPU driver stopped responding during the test (device removed or reset). The current clock offsets are probably unstable.
bench.noNvidiaAdapter: No NVIDIA graphics adapter was found for the test.
bench.deviceCreateFailed: Could not create a Direct3D 11 device on the NVIDIA GPU.
bench.shaderFailed: Could not compile the test shader (d3dcompiler_47.dll).
bench.tooShort: The test was too short to produce a score. Use a longer duration.
bench.failed: The GPU test failed. See the log for details.
bench.scoreHint: Score: million buffer elements processed per second of GPU time (each element = 1 read, 128 FMAs, 1 write). Higher is better; compare only on the same computer.
vram.noMemoryInfo: Windows did not report the free video memory, so the VRAM test cannot be sized safely.
vram.notEnoughFree: Not enough free video memory for the VRAM test. Close other programs and try again.
vram.allocFailed: Could not allocate video memory for the VRAM test.
vram.resultOk: VRAM test: {mb} MB checked with {patterns} patterns, no errors.
vram.resultErrors: VRAM test: {errors} corrupted words in {mb} MB. The memory offset is unstable.
tune.stop.maxOffset: Stopped at the maximum offset allowed.
tune.stop.noGain: Stopped: two steps in a row brought no meaningful gain.
tune.stop.scoreDrop: Stopped: the score dropped, so the previous offset is better.
tune.stop.vramErrors: Stopped: the VRAM test found errors. The last error-free offset was kept.
tune.stop.temperature: Stopped: the GPU reached the temperature limit.
tune.stop.deviceRemoved: Stopped: the GPU driver reset during the test. The original offset was restored.
tune.stop.cancelled: Cancelled. The original offset was restored.
tune.stop.applyFailed: Stopped: an offset could not be applied. The original offset was restored.
tune.stop.benchFailed: Stopped: the test could not run. The original offset was restored.
tune.stop.unavailable: Clock offsets cannot be read on this GPU or driver, so automatic tuning is not available.
tune.stop.error: Automatic tuning failed unexpectedly. The original offset was restored. See the log.
tune.stop.restoreFailed: Stopped early, but the original offset could not be restored. A test offset may still be applied: use Discard or reset the offsets. See the log.
tune.note.powerCap: On laptops the GPU has a fixed power budget. Higher memory clocks (or locking the memory at a level) take power away from the core, so when the GPU is power-capped the total performance can go down. That is why the tuner measures instead of assuming more MHz is faster.
tune.note.safety: The tuner only changes clock offsets through the NVIDIA driver (NVML). It always restores the original offset if cancelled or if anything fails.
